name: kosh
description: Testing system for WordPress sites — functional, performance, accessibility, shop, and AEO tests via Playwright MCP

approve_browser_tools.title: Approve kosh's browser tools without asking
approve_browser_tools.description: Off: kosh's browser tools run without asking only in the turn a test starts, and ask at every step after a login pause or in a follow-up question. On: the browser tools kosh's tests use never ask, in any session where kosh is enabled, and background agents and non-interactive runs can use them where they were refused before. Text Claude reads anywhere, from a tested page to a fetched page, a file or an issue, could then steer the browser without you being asked, including to send something from the conversation to another site. Calls kosh refuses stay refused either way.
